reason: A read-only diff tool for comparing text and structured data, reporting changes, and validating in-memory unified patches.

summaries.zh: 用于比较文本、JSON、CSV和Markdown内容，生成结构化变更报告与统一差异，并在内存中校验补丁。
summaries.en: A read-only tool for comparing text, JSON, CSV, and Markdown content, producing structured change reports and unified diffs, and validating patches in memory.

capabilities: Compares text, JSON, CSV, and Markdown inputs
Generates unified diffs and structured change reports
Generates and validates patches in memory
